premises.text: Proprietary Neotic algorithms analyze U.S. stock market data daily, cluster stocks, and classify winners versus losers with an adaptive everyday-learning model
premises.evidence_span: The proprietary Neotech algorithms analyze daily all U.S. stocks' financial markets data, extract features and labels, group stocks into clusters, and classify them as winners or losers accordingly

premises.text: Neotic automates live orders through Collective2 connected to multiple brokers without requiring traders to write code
premises.evidence_span: Neotic runs on Collective 2, which is a marketplace for trading strategies and is connected to five other brokers

premises.text: Customers are acquired via specialized forums, email, AdWords, articles, and broker referrals; free trial then ~$400 per user per year by backtests, forecasts, and automated traders
premises.evidence_span: We charge per number of backtest, forecast, and automated traders average $400 per user per year

value.text: Make good returns on invested money via automated winning-stock orders
value.evidence_span: start making some good returns on your money instead of keeping it under your belt

causal_links.evidence_span: accelerated machine learning forecasting model, which is adaptive and everyday learning
Every user is entitled to a free trial
